aboutText: Protek Electrical & Data is a family-focused electrical business proudly serving Point Cook and Melbourne's western suburbs. Our team is rigorously trained in both customer service and electrical safety, fully insured, and available around the clock for emergencies. Every technician is neat, clean, and uniformed — nobody we wouldn't want in our own homes. We deliver knowledgeable, experienced, and reliable electrical and data solutions with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.
servicesText: From emergency callouts to full-scale commercial fitouts, Protek Electrical & Data handles every job with the same care and professionalism. We specialise in residential wiring, commercial switchboards, data cabling, and cutting-edge CCTV security installations using world-leading brands.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Services
services.desc: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Rapid response to urgent electrical faults, power outages, and safety hazards across Point Cook and Melbourne's west.

services.title: Residential Electrical Work
services.desc: Complete home electrical services including switchboard upgrades, lighting installations, power point additions, and full rewiring for new builds and renovations.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Solutions
services.desc: Switchboard upgrades, fitouts, and ongoing maintenance for offices, retail spaces, and industrial facilities. Licensed and qualified for commercial-scale projects.

services.title: CCTV & Security Installation
services.desc: Professional installation of Hikvision, Dahua, Bosch, and Samsung CCTV systems. Custom security solutions tailored to your property's specific requirements.

services.title: Data & Network Cabling
services.desc: Structured data cabling, network setup, and communications infrastructure for homes and businesses. Ensuring reliable connectivity throughout your property.

services.title: Electrical Safety & Maintenance
services.desc: Comprehensive safety inspections, test and tag services, RCD testing, and preventive maintenance programs to keep your property compliant and safe.
